note: H88: a sentinel computed, documented as "not clear", and read by the one branch that could not tell it from clear. Two-sided against the pre-fix copy.

controls.name: negative_control_prefix
controls.must_fire_because: the probe must be able to SEE the defect, or the live arm reading clean means nothing
controls.can_fail_because: point the pre-fix arm at the repaired file and it reads DEFECT_ABSENT
controls.null_must_contain: the pre-fix census line pair, which differ only if the fix is present
controls.detail: bringup.before_h88.sh: absent and nfail=0 print byte-identical census lines

controls.name: live_file_repaired
controls.must_fire_because: the claim recorded is that the LIVE bringup.sh no longer collapses absent into 0
controls.can_fail_because: remove the fnote assignment or any of its four print sites and it reads DEFECT_PRESENT
controls.null_must_contain: an absent-counter census line, which the pre-v2 file emits identically to nfail=0
controls.detail: bringup.sh v2: absent emits the NO FAIL COUNTER suffix, nfail=0 does not

controls.name: runnable_check_green
controls.must_fire_because: section 12.3 -- the component keeps a check that fails when it breaks; this is that check RUN
controls.can_fail_because: either arm returning the other verdict, or controls_ok=false, exits 1
controls.null_must_contain: either arm disagreeing with its expected verdict

controls.name: fix_removal_detected
controls.must_fire_because: a check nobody has broken on purpose is a check nobody has tested (M1_10: 2 of 4 probes scored clean against the bug fully present)
controls.can_fail_because: a check watching the ASSIGNMENT instead of the OUTPUT would miss F2 and this reads FAIL
controls.null_must_contain: an untouched copy, which must stay DEFECT_ABSENT
controls.detail: both mutations detected, control green; mutations asserted non-no-op by cmp

falsifiers.name: H88 was never a defect
falsifiers.can_fail_because: the PRE-FIX bringup.before_h88.sh already prints something for absent that it does not print for 0
falsifiers.detail: did not fire: the pre-fix file collapses absent into 0
falsifiers.refutes: the row's claim that ABSENT and nfail=0 were indistinguishable
falsifiers.fires_when: the PRE-FIX bringup.before_h88.sh already prints something for absent that it does not print for 0
falsifiers.verdict: survived — the falsifier did not fire

falsifier: if an absent .loop_fails already produced output distinguishable from nfail=0 in the PRE-FIX file, the defect was never there and H88 is withdrawn
